outcome: Morphine milligram equivalents prescribed at discharge
Number of opioid tablets prescribed at discharge
cohort: Women undergoing cesarean delivery (412 in the personalized prescribing group, 367 in the traditional prescribing group)
finding: A personalized opioid prescribing protocol after cesarean delivery significantly reduced morphine milligram equivalents and the number of opioid tablets prescribed at discharge without increasing pain control issues or readmissions.
